type: sudo sh -c 'P=/dev/virtio-ports/hscl.qa; L(){ echo "Q61| $*" >$P; }; [ -e $P ]||{ echo no-port >&2; exit 1; }; L start $(date -Is); for S in hscl-calamares calamares-launch-normal calamares; do for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do setsid /usr/bin/$S >/tmp/o.$S.$i 2>&1 & sleep 15; s=$(ps -o sid= -C calamares|head -1|tr -d " "); L "$S $i alive=$(pgrep -cx calamares) out=$(wc -c </tmp/o.$S.$i) sid=$s"; [ -n "$s" ] && kill -9 -$s; sleep 5; done; done; L log; sed "s/^/Q61|  /" /tmp/hscl-calamares.log >$P; L journal; journalctl -b|grep -E "app-|KCrash|Killed|Killing process|SIGKILL|oom-kill"|sed "s/^/Q61|  /" >$P; L launchscript; cat /usr/bin/calamares-launch-normal >$P; L end'
